stem: Contrary to its reputation for intellectual ____, the 1950s was a decade exceptionally rich in works of trenchant and far-reaching social criticism.
In light of Elizabeth’s habitually (i)____ nature, her friends were quite surprised by her (ii)____ at the convention.

Overall, fish farming may provide a (i)____ wild fish stocks, but for certain species, the farmers cause a net loss of wild fish. Some fish farmers use upwards of five kilograms of wild fish as feed to grow one kilogram of carnivorous species like sea bass. Such (ii)____ feed plus other environmental side effects undermine the expected (iii)____ fish farming.
Computerized facial-recognition systems can be ____ by any number of factors, from the dirt caked on a camera lens to a hat pulled low over a subject’s face.

Some social scientists who begin their studies of small communities with the intention of remaining detached revise their initial approach on discovering that personal involvement with subjects can actually ____ the gathering of important data.
Since their first appearance in the nineteenth century, commuter suburbs have been widely ____ in print as both a social disaster and an aesthetic desert.
In denying him a promotion, management cited his ____ decision making, charging that his judgements were based on vagaries rather than careful forethought.
